_comment: Curated overrides applied by tools/unify.py.
merge : spreadsheet component name -> canonical component name.
Both sides are run through normalize.name_key(), so casing,
punctuation and spacing do not matter.
names : canonical name -> the display name the master should use.
drop  : component names that are not components (section notes,
footers, separators).
Candidates for new entries are generated in data/review_name_clusters.csv.
Only merge names you are confident describe the same physical part -- the
review file deliberately lists look-alikes (SHCS vs BHCS, 2- vs 3-position)
that must stay separate.

_comment: Parts that are machine-specific even when different tabs give them the
same name. These never merge across tabs -- each project keeps its own
item, with a `scope` field and a project-suffixed id.
Panels: every printer's panels are cut to that printer.
Beds: a 350mm Trident bed and a 350mm 2.4 bed are not the same plate.
Pairs/groups that look alike but are different parts. Reviewed and
rejected, so tools/report.py stops surfacing them in
review_name_clusters.csv. Every name in a group is distinct from every
other name in that group.
Machine-specific, but shared between revisions of the same machine.
A 350mm Trident bed is not a 350mm 2.4 bed, but the V0, V0.1 and V0.2
bed is one plate. Scoped per printer family rather than per tab.
